compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The rebar code-review gate returns BLOCK while listing no findings. Three of the last four runs against this repository failed that way, and the only way past it was to raise `REBAR_GROUNDING_TIMEOUT` to 600.

A BLOCK carrying no findings comes from the fail-closed rule in `rebar/llm/code_review/detectors.py`. The gate runs its deterministic detectors, buckets each one's evidence per criterion, and turns an abstain on `secret-detection` or `high-critical-security` into a BLOCK with a coverage-gap note. The abstain reason recorded on every one of them is `timeout`, raised by `p.communicate(timeout=call_timeout)` at `rebar/grounding/harness.py:201` against the 60 second `_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` at `harness.py:48`.

The detectors do not read the attested snapshot the gate reviews. `finalize.py:337` passes `repo_root=request.repo_root`, which `shim.py` fills with the working checkout. `engine_b_backends.py:471` then runs `gitleaks detect --no-git --source <repo_root>` and `engine_b_backends.py:55` runs `opengrep scan --no-git-ignore <repo_root>`. Both flags disable the tools' own ignore handling, so both walk gitignored directories.

This checkout holds `.agent-workspaces` at 23 GB, the `execution_workspace_root` default from `scripts/config.py:170`, which holds full clones of the repositories the platform is working on. So the gate reads other repositories' source on every run, and both tools overrun the budget doing it.

## Grounded measurements

Each figure is `run_detectors` at the default 60 second budget, with per-tool timings taken by wrapping `harness.run_tool`.

- Working checkout, twice: 137.4s and 136.9s, 10 abstains, all `timeout`. `secret-detection` 1, `high-critical-security` 3, `public-exposure-without-auth` 5, `conflict-markers` 1.
- The gate's own attested snapshot of the same commit, which `git checkout-index` builds from tracked files only: 18.5s, 0 abstains.
- The same checkout hardlinked without `.agent-workspaces`, so `.venv` and `vendor` are still present: 21.3s, 0 abstains. This isolates the workspace root as the cause and clears the other two.
- gitleaks alone: 76.3s unscoped, 0.98s once the workspace root is excluded.
- opengrep scan alone: over budget unscoped, 48.5s with only the workspace root excluded, 9.2s with all three non-source trees excluded.

A user-supplied `.semgrepignore` replaces the tool's built-in defaults rather than adding to them, which is why the file has to name `.venv` and `vendor` even though neither causes the failure on its own. Without the file opengrep already skips them.

## Approach

Give each scanner an ignore rule naming the trees that do not carry this repository's source, so the gate reads this repository and nothing else.

`.gitleaks.toml` extends the default rules and allowlists the three paths. gitleaks matches allowlist regexes against absolute paths, so the patterns are unanchored on purpose. `.semgrepignore` lists the same three, restoring the two defaults it displaces.

Excluding the workspace root is what fixes the timeout. `.venv` and `vendor` are listed because they are third-party trees this repository's review gate has no reason to analyse, and because omitting them from `.semgrepignore` would widen the opengrep scan rather than narrow it.

Raising `REBAR_GROUNDING_TIMEOUT` in `_rebar_gate_env` was rejected. It leaves the gate reading other repositories' source, and the workspace root grows with every execution, so the budget would have to keep rising.

## Scope

Per-file reasons are in this ticket's file impact. All three files are new.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both scanner configurations name the `execution_workspace_root` default, verified by a test reading the field off `Settings` rather than repeating the literal.
- [ ] gitleaks reports a planted secret in the source tree, verified by `tests/integration/test_gate_scanner_scope.py`.
- [ ] gitleaks reports no planted secret from any non-source tree, verified by the same module.
- [ ] opengrep reports a planted match in the source tree, verified by the same module.
- [ ] opengrep reports no planted match from any non-source tree, verified by the same module.
- [ ] The scanner tests skip when the tool binary is absent, verified by reading the skip markers.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The gate's detector sweep over this checkout records no abstain at the default budget.
  provenance: environment=local-macos-host; principal=joeoakhart; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the sweep runs the shipped `run_detectors` entrypoint against the working checkout
- [ ] `ruff check adapters services scripts tests` exits 0.
- [ ] The full test suite passes.
